title: Synthetic case: functional overview
prompt: A clean, flat infographic for a fictional research summary. Show three panels: intake of a synthetic case code, classification of findings with an explicit 'unclassified' label for uncertain variants, and a reviewer sign-off step. Label everything as research and decision support, not clinical advice. Use no real names, no real identifiers, and no patient imagery.

title: Synthetic case: technical pipeline
prompt: A clean, flat technical diagram of a gated review pipeline. Show a state machine with boxes for intake, classification, draft, and sign-off, with gate markers on the transitions labelled as an uncertain-variant gate and a pharmacogenomic critical gate. Use no real names, no real identifiers, and no patient imagery.
